attchmntText: Suprajit Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Suprajit Engineering Limited has filed an audio recording of meetings with analysts and institutional investors held on November 12, 2026. This submission is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The recording is available on the company website at the specified link. The filing follows a previous letter dated October 27, 2026. The document was signed by Medappa Gowda J, CFO and Company Secretary.

attchmntText: Suprajit Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Suprajit Engineering Limited has intimated the schedule for its Investors Day 2026 meeting. The event is scheduled for Thursday, November 19, 2026, in Bengaluru. The purpose is to provide a deep dive into the business divisions. Activities include a plant visit to the Suprajit Electronic Division, GCM India, and the Experience Centre. The meeting will also feature presentations and interactions with top management. The company confirms that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared. Latest investor presentations have been filed with BSE and NSE. These documents are available on the company website. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies.

attchmntText: Suprajit Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Suprajit Engineering Limited has published a newspaper advertisement regarding its financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisement was published in the Financial Express English newspaper and the Sanjevani Kannada newspaper. The notice was issued on November 12, 2026. The document was signed by Medappa Gowda J, who serves as the Chief Financial Officer and Company Secretary. The company has requested that the exchanges take this information into their records.
